en: these (as object); to these; to him/her (honorific); to them
issue: IPA: final anusvara is vowel nasalisation, not a consonant [n]; ह is ɦ in house style (was ɪnheːn)

en: finally; at last; in the end
issue: IPA: ख़ carries a nukta, so it is x, not aspirated kʰ (was aːkʰɪrkaːr)

en: with a thud; bang; crash (sound of a heavy fall)
issue: IPA: ध is the breathy voiced dʱ, not voiceless-aspirated dʰ; POS is onomatopoeic adverb (cf. झमाझम), not noun
